description: Send a prompt or a conversation to a language model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi) and get the reply. Defaults to anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5. Pass system for instructions, messages for multi-turn or vision (image parts), json for JSON mode. Returns the reply text plus finish_reason and token usage. Synchronous: no task to poll. Bills per token on the account balance; dry_run_cost does not apply to LLMs (cost depends on the actual tokens) — the charge shows up in list_tasks with category 'llm'. This is for running ANOTHER model on the user's behalf (a second opinion, a specific model they asked for, bulk/structured extraction) — not for answering something you can answer yourself.

json.description: Set true for JSON mode (response_format { type: 'json_object' }) on models that support it. Tell the model the shape you want in the prompt.

max_tokens.description: Cap on completion tokens. Omit for the model's default; a reply with finish_reason 'length' was cut off here.

messages.description: Full conversation in OpenAI chat format: [{ role: 'system'|'user'|'assistant'|'tool', content }]. content is a string, or an array of parts for vision models: [{ type: 'text', text }, { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url } }] — image URLs must be public https (upload_file first); never base64. If prompt is also given it is appended as a final user message.

model.description: Model, as a short alias or full id. Aliases: 'claude' / 'sonnet' (default, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5), 'opus', 'haiku', 'fable', 'gpt', 'gemini', 'grok-chat', 'deepseek', 'kimi'. Full ids like 'openai/gpt-5.5' or 'xai/grok-4.7' also work. See list_models with category 'llm'.

prompt.description: The user message. Shorthand for messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }]. Give either prompt or messages.

provider_options.description: Escape hatch for Chat Completions fields without a named parameter (tools, tool_choice, response_format with a schema, seed, ...). Merged into the request body. Rejected: fields the tool already manages (model, messages, and any named parameter you set) and stream — this tool returns one complete reply.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for models that support it (e.g. 'low', 'medium', 'high'; allowed values vary by model).

system.description: System instructions, prepended as a system message. Shorthand for a { role: 'system' } entry in messages.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, 0 to 2. Omit for the model's default.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling. Omit for the model's default.

name: chat
title: Chat with an LLM
